question: What three classes of variants are associated with the ābhāsa type?
premises: The terms jāti, chanda and vikalpa name variant classes.
These are presented together as a group.
They are related to the ābhāsa type.
inference: The jāti, chanda and vikalpa variants are associated with the ābhāsa type.
plain_english: O best of the twice-born, the jāti, chanda and vikalpa variants are associated with the ābhāsa.
